updates.note: Management reiterated the PBDIT margin band of 18-20 percent.
updates.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

updates.note: Management reiterated the volume growth target of 8-10% for FY27.
updates.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

updates.note: Management reiterated that the first phase of the VAM-VAE project will commence in August (H1 FY27).
updates.quote: The first phase of this initiative will commence by August.

new_promises.statement: We aim to reach a VAE capacity closer to 150,000 MT over the next 2-2.5 years.
new_promises.quote: Our feeling is that possibly over a period of about 2-2.5 years, we should be able to reach basically a capacity which is higher and closer to about 150,000 MT.
new_promises.speaker: Amit Syngle
